title: Ball fall time
description: Essential: Correctly calculates the free-fall time using t = sqrt(2h/g) with given values.

title: Box maximum displacement
description: Essential: Correctly calculates the maximum rightward displacement of the box (0.9 m) using kinematics and the initial deceleration.

title: Box final velocity
description: Essential: Correctly calculates the velocity of the box when the ball leaves (2.8 m/s).

title: Acceleration stages
description: Important: Identifies and calculates the two distinct accelerations (a1 during rightward motion, a2 after reversal) using Newton's second law with correct friction forces.

title: Ball initial condition
description: Important: States that the ball's initial horizontal velocity relative to the ground is zero when placed.

title: Displacement for ball exit
description: Important: Correctly determines the total leftward distance (x2 = x1 + L/3) the box must travel for the ball to reach its edge and fall.

title: Time for leftward motion
description: Important: Correctly calculates the time for the box to travel distance x2 to the left with constant acceleration a2.

title: Unit consistency
description: Optional: Maintains consistent units (m, s, m/s, m/s²) throughout the solution.

title: Sign error in forces
description: Pitfall: Uses the wrong sign for friction or applied force when calculating acceleration, especially after the box reverses direction.

title: Incorrect mass for friction
description: Pitfall: Uses the wrong mass (M instead of M+m) for calculating the friction force while the ball is on the box.
